official_measurement_examples.name: Part S scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part S covers specified new, changed-use and major-renovation building work.

official_measurement_examples.name: Associated parking
official_measurement_examples.fact: Requirements depend on associated parking as defined by Approved Document S.

official_measurement_examples.name: Cable routes
official_measurement_examples.fact: More than 10 associated spaces can trigger additional cable-route requirements for new residential buildings.

official_measurement_examples.name: Connection cost
official_measurement_examples.fact: The FAQ uses an average £3,600 connection-cost test in specified new-residential cases.

official_measurement_examples.name: Technical output
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document S guidance specifies a 7 kW minimum nominal rated output for relevant charge points.

official_measurement_examples.name: Product regime
official_measurement_examples.fact: Smart charge-point product regulations are separate from Part S Building Regulations.

official_measurement_examples.name: OPSS role
official_measurement_examples.fact: OPSS actions concern product compliance, not development-site planning or building-control decisions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Network offer
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part S compliance does not reserve network capacity or constitute a DNO connection offer.
